name: BXI Robotics
summary: BXI Robotics, known in Chinese as Banxing Technology, is a humanoid robot and actuator manufacturer founded in Huangpu, Shanghai. It develops the Elf humanoid series, hollow-shaft planetary joint motors, robot control modules and a dual-arm teleoperation platform. Its Shanghai team handles research and development, with machining and assembly in Shenzhen. The company also offers OEM and ODM programs covering robot design, component selection and system integration.
